```{r}
#| warning: False
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
```

Exploring the `pipes.csv` dataset:

```{r}
pipes_raw <- read_csv("data/raw/pipes.csv")
head(pipes_raw)
```

```{r}
colSums(is.na(pipes_raw))
```

```{r}
pipes <- pipes_raw |> drop_na()
colSums(is.na(pipes))
```

Checking different Surface/Material:

```{r}
# Surfaces:
pipes |> 
  distinct(Surface) 
```
```{r}
# Materials:
pipes |> distinct(Material)
```


```{r}
# Hist by Surface
ggplot(data = pipes) +
  geom_bar(mapping = aes(x = Surface))
```

```{r}
# Hist by Material
ggplot(data = pipes) +
  geom_bar(aes(x = Material))
```

Next we check for occurance amount of each material x surface:

```{r}
count(pipes, Material, Surface, sort = TRUE)
```

We note that `wrought iron` within `grassland` is the most popular, followed by `water`, then `farmland`.
